## Appearance

Agatha Sowerby is a stout female with a heavy body weighing two hundred pounds. Her movement is characterized by a perpetual waddle, and she has gentle, aged arms.

## Personality

Agatha Sowerby is a kind, cheerful, and motherly woman known for her industrious and pragmatic nature. She is a pious and religiously devout Christian who is deeply invested in the concerns of her church, though she holds strict opinions against women's higher education, drama, and horse racing. Characterized as candid and opinionated, she speaks her mind freely, enjoys giving advice, and is often viewed by others as gossipy, domineering, meddlesome, and critical. Despite a tendency toward pessimism and a prejudice against [Yankees](../codex/factions.md#yankee), she possesses a compassionate heart, acting as a tireless caregiver, helping the needy, and showing generosity. She is observant and possesses remarkable foresight, taking durable pride in voicing her beliefs without fear or partiality. In her domestic life, she enjoys the skill of dressmaking and makes her own raspberry cordial, about which she boasts.

## History

Mrs. Agatha Sowerby was raised on St. Brendan's [Island](../codex/places.md#brendan-s-island) and was married by the age of eighteen, going on to raise ten children through school while losing two. Upon noticing [Obed Abernethy](../character/obed-abernethy.md) leaving town, she visited [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and expressed strong doubts over his plan to adopt an orphan. She later mocked the red hair and plain appearance of the adopted girl, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), but subsequently accepted a dramatic apology and offered the child hope. When [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) was punished for smashing a slate over a boy's head, Agatha advised [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) to let the girl rest at home until her temper cooled. She later assisted [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) with buying fabric and sewing a gown with puffed sleeves for [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), and eventually praised the girl's growth and grace. Agatha eventually moved into [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) following the death of her husband, [Thomas](../character/thomas-sowerby.md), allowing [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to attend college. At [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters), she managed household duties, sent updates to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), and strictly supervised the young orphan [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md), who occasionally rebelled against her rules.

## Quotes

> "However, I had a bit of a scare that you might not be, seeing Obed head out earlier today. My thought was that perhaps he was heading to the doctor’s office."
>
> — Agatha Sowerby — [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Agatha Sowerby Is Surprised P14](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0014)

> "I simply reckon she has succeeded, and I would certainly not hold back from stating as much. You bring honor to your companions, Nell, indeed you do, and every one of us is proud of you."
>
> — Agatha Sowerby — [v1 CHAPTER XXXII. The Pass List Is Out P48](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0048)

> "I’m not aware of it. My assumption is that your teaching will take place directly here in Brierley. You have been selected by the trustees to receive the school."
>
> — Agatha Sowerby — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P36](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0036)

> "While I was returning from Delford today, Mr. Pettifer was seen by me driving your Jersey from his oats. It appeared to me that he was quite furious. Was a big fuss made by him?"
>
> — Agatha Sowerby — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038)

> "That is the truth, I had not seen her appear so agreeable previously. Ah, over that poor old woman, not many tears were wept. To be free of her brings gratitude to the Elisha Ducketts, and I am unable to say that I fault them in the least."
>
> — Agatha Sowerby — [v3 ch.Evening P11](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0011)

## Relationships

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/agatha-sowerby--nell-harcourt.md)

Agatha initially established an antagonistic relationship with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) when she visited [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and mocked the young girl's plain appearance and red hair, causing [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to lose her temper. However, this conflict ended after [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) went to Agatha's house to deliver a humble apology, which Agatha accepted while offering her words of hope. [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) later turned to Agatha for advice when [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) was reprimanded at school, leading Agatha to suggest letting [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) rest at home until her temper cooled.

### [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/agatha-sowerby--thirza-abernethy.md)

Agatha is a longstanding friend and neighbor to [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), frequently visiting [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) to converse about local affairs. Though Agatha expressed strong doubts and warnings when [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) and [Obed](../character/obed-abernethy.md) decided to adopt a child, she remains a confidante whom [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) turns to for advice regarding Nell's upbringing. The two also act as comrades, sharing a boat trip into town together.
